description: `vein add` on a task already in the vein succeeds and records a second "added Coalesce invoice.paid events to vein Batch Stripe webhooks" Activity row, although nothing changed.
expected: A no-op link is reported as already linked and adds no event (or is replayed silently).
suggested_fix: Make task.link-vein idempotent for an already-linked pair, with no new event.

description: `vein remove` without --revisions fails with "Supply --revisions", but does not say which revision is needed or where to read it (`vein show` → tasks[].linkRevisions). `vein add` needs no revision, so the pair is asymmetric.
expected: The error names linkRevisions and the command that returns them, or remove uses the current link revision when there is no concurrency.
suggested_fix: Include the hint `pardner vein show <vein>` → tasks[].linkRevisions in the error details.

description: Tasks can be attached to a vein only from the CLI. A person on the board or in the task panel has no way to add or remove vein membership, although the board already shows vein labels and a Vein filter.
expected: A Vein field in task details (and in New task when the board is vein-filtered).
suggested_fix: Add a vein multi-select to task details.
